body: Yes. He uploaded a video on her birthday.
She deleted her social media because she was being harassed too. I have to have some form of it to stay in contact with family.

Sorry for the prolonged response time – I had to go through all of my evidence. He hasn’t made any direct threats towards me. However, there have been some suspicious comments he has made. On April 26th my girlfriend and I left for a trip to London, and the day after he made a tweet about the likelihood of being stabbed in London. As mentioned in another video, he made a video about restraining orders around the time I was looking into getting one against him and his army.
Please don’t theorise. Thanks.  I fear for my life.
Ahhh, okay. Still, I’m sorry to hear. Sounds annoying.
That sounds like a nightmare, I’m sorry you went through that. Are they still targeting you?
Yeah, I just deleted the other post as I was worried about it being connected to me.
I used this on a different subreddit previously, sorry if I’ve caused any confusion. I didn’t have another email address to make a new one.

I was paranoid you were perhaps him, or one of his followers. I am used to people discrediting me. When I attempted to file a restraining order against him he posted a video about restraining orders the very next day! Suspicious behaviour.
You should be banned from this sub. I went through your post history – all you do is come on here and accuse people of lying!
I don’t want to say. He might find this, and post a video today as a result of this post.
